data.title: 天雨亚子 · 居室床榻的真丝吊带娇羞
data.description: 歌赫娜风纪委专属休息室内，亚子换下了平日拘谨威严的风纪官制服，仅穿着深色真丝细吊带睡衣侧坐在床铺上。灰色双马尾垂在光洁圆润的香肩两侧，平时严厉苛刻的管理官，此刻紧抿着薄唇，湛蓝眼眸水汽氤氲地望向前方，满面通红地展现出反差强烈的依恋与少女娇态。
data.action: sitting on plush bed in dark silk camisole, grey twintails framing bare collarbones, clutching soft blanket, blushing intensely with downcast then meeting eyes
data.location: private luxury bedroom with dark mahogany and velvet decor
data.lighting: warm dim bedside lamp illuminating bare shoulders and blushing cheeks
data.mood: intense gap-moe vulnerability, sweet surrendered pride
data.promptProse: Sitting on her bed in a sleek dark silk camisole, Amau Ako looks up with flushed cheeks. Her grey twintails cascade over bare shoulders as her blue eyes glimmer with a flustered, devoted vulnerability.
data.animaCaption: Ako sitting on her bed in a dark silk camisole, blushing intensely with grey twintails.
